value.title: The Glossary
value.description: There's nothing worse than getting home from the store with a new nail polish and realizing you already own something similar. This is my fix – every shade I own, so next time I'm at the store I actually know what's on my shelf. Click or hover over any bottle to see more information.

text.value: The data lives in a Google Sheet – each row is a polish with its name, brand, hex value, finish type  and a swatch photo. The app fetches it directly, so adding a new polish to my collection is as simple as adding a row.

Every bottle is a custom SVG I drew in Illustrator, filled with the actual hex value of each shade. The finish type is stored in the sheet and controls how the bottle renders: metallics get a diagonal shimmer gradient, glitters get crosshatch sparkles.

Getting the hex values right took some trial and error. I ended up using a Chrome eyedropper extension on sourced swatch photos to pull the most accurate color for each shade. I also used Figma to sketch out the layout before writing any code. The app is built with Svelte, hosted on Netlify, and copy is managed with ArchieML.
View the source code for this page on GitHub.
